jobs.description:
Standort: ERL S SP 9

Fachabteilung: SE GT SV PFS FS MR SG

Eingruppierung: Germany ERA-EG 5

Art der Anstellung: Full-Time / Permanent

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our dedicated Customer Service specialists as they independently carry out maintenance and modernization measures for energy transmission networks at our international clients. You will engage in service activities involving high-voltage switchgear and components of energy transmission, both domestically and abroad, including onshore and some offshore projects. Our specialists receive qualification and certification through our in-house training center on product-related topics, as well as from external partners (e.g., TÜV). This ensures you become highly specialized while having access to extensive documentation and valuable know-how from our back office.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Serve as the primary on-site contact for service operations at our clients’ locations, both domestically and internationally.
* Execute maintenance, inspections, fault analyses, and troubleshooting independently and systematically.
* Conduct measurements to assess the condition of components and derive necessary maintenance actions.
* Create documentation for service operations, including service reports and site logs.
* Lead your own teams as a supervisor as you gain experience.

What You Bring

* A successfully completed vocational training in electrical engineering (e.g., as a Mechatronics Technician, Industrial Electrician, or Electronics Technician).
* Initial professional experience in service activities related to energy transmission components is desirable.
* High willingness to travel (approximately 90%) for short- and medium-term assignments both domestically and internationally.
* Comfort working at heights and on scaffolding.
* Strong reliability, independence, commitment, teamwork, and a customer-oriented mindset.
* Proficient in German and good command of English, both spoken and written, along with a valid driver’s license (Class B).

About the Team

With the increasing share of renewable energy, growing energy demand, outdated infrastructure, and rising complexity, new connections are needed. Additionally, existing networks require upgrades and renewals to support the energy transition.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With over 100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme

We also offer the opportunity to become a shareholder of Siemens Energy 

We offer a wide range of options for balancing family and career, such as flexible working time models, childcare facilities at many locations, the option of trial part-time work or a sabbatical

The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Junior Specialist - Technical Support (m/f/d) *dutch and german speaking* (Ingenieur/in - Service/Instandhaltung)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche, you can be yourself and are valued for your uniqueness. Our corporate culture fosters personal development, open dialogue, and authentic connections. As a pioneer in healthcare, we know: Every minute counts. When a diagnostic system in a laboratory stands still, patients are waiting for vital results. You ensure that our systems run smoothly, thus contributing directly to securing the healthcare of tomorrow. Become part of Roche, where every voice matters.

Your new team:

You will be part of our EMEA Customer Support Center Hub here in Mannheim. We are a team of technical and application experts supporting customers in the RCSC countries (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Greece, and Turkey). Cohesion and working in intercultural teams are important to us; we work closely networked, including with 2nd-level support and our colleagues in the field.

Responsibilities | What awaits you

As a Junior Specialist (m/f/d), you are the technical interface to our customers and colleagues. Your goal is to find fast and sustainable solutions for complex inquiries. Your main tasks include:
* As the central point of contact, you process customer and employee inquiries digital or by phone.
* You use remote services for customer support and, if necessary, simulate customer situations in our laboratory to quickly identify and resolve errors.
* You document your solution approaches structured in our CRM system and handle advanced complaint management for medium-complexity issues.
* You work closely with 2nd-level support and escalate product quality problems to the next competence level. Occasionally, you also support the technical field service during on-site activities.

Qualifications | What you bring

In addition to successfully completed training as a Medical Technical Assistant (MTA), Technician (e.g., Mechatronics, Medical Technology, Electrical Engineering), or a Bachelor's degree (e.g., Natural Sciences, IT, Chemical or Electrical Engineering), you have initial professional experience in the medical technology field – be it in customer support, service, marketing, or directly in a service function in a laboratory. Furthermore, the following points round out your profile:
* You speak fluent Dutch/Flemish and German (C1). You also communicate confidently in English (min. B1/B2).
* You have good user knowledge of medical analysis systems or, alternatively, know-how in robotics, mechanics, or electrical engineering. Basic IT network knowledge and familiarity with CRM tools are familiar to you.
* You are strongly customer-oriented, a real team player in intercultural teams, and possess pronounced methodical competence in troubleshooting.

Your Application 

We ask you for the following documents:

* Current CV

Further documents are not mandatory at this time. Please note before submitting your application that no further documents can be added afterward.

Apply now – we look forward to it!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Do you need further support?

Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join us as an EHS Manager (f/m/d), where you will play a pivotal role in supporting and advising the GT Transformer business on essential environmental, health, and safety (EHS) requirements. Imagine driving initiatives that foster a culture of safe behavior and helping us climb the safety culture ladder. You will lead training initiatives within the EQS team, ensuring continuous improvement under our Zero Harm framework and integrated management systems, particularly focusing on ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards. Your analytical skills will shine as you track incident statistics and support root cause analyses, all while promoting regulatory compliance and closing any gaps.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Drive initiatives to enhance a culture of safety within the organization
* Lead and support necessary EHS training initiatives to promote awareness and compliance
* Analyze EHS data and report incident statistics to identify trends and areas for improvement
* Provide guidance on environmental, health, and safety issues, ensuring regulatory compliance
* Facilitate regular meetings within the EQS community to promote information exchange and updates
* Support root cause analysis of EHS events and track identified actions for continuous improvement

What You Bring

* A Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as engineering, industrial engineering, or environmental engineering
* Several years of EHS experience in manufacturing or a related industry, ideally within Grid Technologies
* Strong communication skills, akin to those of an influencer or salesperson, to effectively promote safety culture
* Training as a specialist in occupational safety is a significant advantage
* Experience in high-risk activities such as cranes & lifting, machine guarding, and energy isolation
* Proficiency in EHS management systems (ISO 14001; ISO 45001) and skills in auditing and root cause investigation
* Good written and spoken German and English skills, with a willingness to travel occasionally

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs 

#RPO

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The BOXER 8x8 is the leading armoured vehicle with a multi-national user background that has been developed in a joint co-operation programme between Germany and the Netherlands by the international consortium ARTEC GmbH in Munich, Germany. ARTEC is a joint-venture of KNDS Deutschland GmbH & Co. KG, Rheinmetall Landsysteme GmbH and Rheinmetall Defence Nederland B.V. It is the prime contractor responsible for the BOXER Programme, the co-ordination of series production and the focal point for export opportunities. Annual sales are normally between 200 and 300 million EUR and as of December 2025 more than 2,000 BOXER vehicles have been contracted. Further large-scale projects are in the pipeline.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

In the role of the Integrated Logistic Support (ILS) Project Engineer BOXER you are responsible for all matters regarding the logistic deliverables of the leading multi-national 8x8 military armoured vehicle programme. At the industry consortium ARTEC, all technical and cross-discipline activities are focused on making a good product even better to protect the future and security of Europe and Worldwide.

Parts of the ILS Project Engineer role:

- Managing and coordination of the contractual ILS requirements of one or several BOXER projects.
- Main emphasis on Logistic Support Analysis (LSA), Technical Documentation (IETP) and Material Management.
- Act as interface between ILS and other disciplines such as Engineering and Safety within ARTEC.
- Assignment and coordination of ILS tasks to specific Main Subcontractors within the Consortium (Rheinmetall and KNDS).
- Coordinating ILS matters and act as the focal point for lLS between industry and Official Services (OCCAR/NSPA).
- Host and chair review meetings with our customer Nations.
- Coordinate activities throughout ARTEC's internal disciplines.
- Be responsible for time, cost and quality for ILS activities in BOXER programme.
- Continuous improvement of processes and monitoring of KPIs.
- Bachelor degree, engineer, technician or comparable qualification.
- Experience in customer support and/or defence area, preferable armoured vehicle manufacturer desired.
- Experience in one of the logistics main disciplines (technical publication, materiel management or logistics support analysis).
- Knowledge of ASD standards, with focus on S1000D and S2000M.
- Working knowledge of MIL-STD-1388 preferred.
- Strong organizational and communication skills.
- Ability to quickly understand and facilitate complex technical relations.
- Business fluent in German and English written and spoken.
- Strong scheduling/planning skills.
- Willingness to travel.

ARTEC is characterized by a flat hierarchy with a project-matrix organisation. This provides the opportunity for you as BOXER ILS Project Engineer to work on multiple international projects with different team members from different countries at the same time.

The office is located in Munich - the most liveable city in Germany.

- Interesting and varied opportunities in a leading role for large scale and demanding International and National projects across the whole life cycle (development, series production, In-Service Support) of a state-of-the art military vehicle.
- Individual training opportunities offered by externals as well as a consortium owned academy.
- A state-of-the-art office that is easily accessible by public or private transport within Munich.
- Attractive payment package and pension.
- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family.
- Flexible working hours incl. 40% mobile working possible as a standard.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Transformers are one of the most important components for energy supply in high and medium voltage networks. Reliable energy transmission is the decisive criterion for our customers. In your daily work, you will develop optimal transformer solutions together with our customers to meet current challenges. A holistic approach, consisting of optimal product design, the selection of suitable monitoring systems, and the definition of tailored service concepts, is always at the forefront.     

How You’ll Make an Impact
 

* Conducting feasibility studies for transformers, as well as creating preliminary transformer designs to determine maximum dimensions and weights 
* Selecting suitable monitoring systems and presenting them to customers 
* Include service and monitoring systems proposition on transformers solutions and presenting them to customers 
* Optimizing interfaces with other products, such as the connection of gas-insulated high-voltage switchgear 
* Collaborating with regional sales, factories, and monitoring- and service departments  
* Capture and translate market trends, customer requirements, and emerging technologies into actionable inputs for product development and portfolio strategy 
* Act as a key technical interface between customers, regional sales teams, and R&D, ensuring alignment of market needs with product capabilities and innovation roadmaps 
* Support strategic customer discussions by providing consultative expertise on transformer solutions within complex grid and substation applications 
* Drive standardization and modularization concepts for transformer design and interfaces, enabling simplification of engineering, reduction of lead times, and improved scalability 
* Identify opportunities to optimize production footprint and maximize factory capacity utilization, balancing customization needs with standardized product approaches

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

 

Day In your new role as Senior Consultant (f/m/d) Grid Integration within our Grid Consulting team, you will be the driving force behind projects that guide our clients — from renewable developers and investors to grid operators — through their most critical decisions. Your day begins by connecting with a client who is w eighing an investment in a new renewable project: you listen, understand their ambitions, and translate them into a clear project roadmap spanning the early investment decision, Pre - FEED and FEED studies, grid code compliance, and — together with our partners — layout and basic design. As the face towards the customer, you own the relationship end - to - end. You are involved in acquir ing new opportunities, shape compelling proposals, and manage projects to successful delivery. Throughout the day you align our internal experts — from network studies specialists to design and commercial colleagues — orchestrating everyone toward a shared goal and ensuring the client always experiences one confiden t, coordinated Siemens Energy voice. You anticipate risks before they surface, keep stakeholders engaged and informed, and make sure every milestone moves the project closer to a sound, bankable outcome. No two days look the same: one moment you are steering a kick - off workshop, the next you are negotiating scope, mentoring colleagues, or presenting results that give a client the confidence to invest. You thrive on this variety — because you know that behind every project you lead stands a real contribution to the energy transition.

 

 

How You’ll Make an Impact

*  Own projects end - to - end   —   from the early investment decision through Pre - FEED and FEED studies   —   taking  full responsibility for scope, schedule, budget, and delivery quality
* Orchestrate cross - functional ,   multi - cultural   teams, aligning network studies specialists, grid code compliance  experts, design   experts , and commercial functions to deliver seamlessly against client expectations.   Manage  stakeholders proactively, anticipating risks, resolving interface and scope challenges early, and keeping all  parties informed and engaged
* Drive grid code compliance as a central thread throughout the project lifecycle, helping clients de - risk their  investments and secure bankable, compliant outcomes
*  Be the face towards the customer, building trusted, long - term relationships and ensuring every client  experiences one confident, coordinated Siemens Energy voice
*  Contribute to team growth by sharing knowledge, mentoring colleagues, and helping evolve our portfolio from  network studies toward holistic, lifecycle advisory

What You Bring

* University degree in electrical power engineering ( M.Sc . or Ph.D ) ,   additional qualifications such as MBA, or  project management certification (e.g., PMP, IPMA) are a strong plus
* Several years of professional experience in the power and energy sector   —   ideally in grid connection,  renewable integration, or transmission systems   —   combined with a proven track record in consulting,   network  studies ,   or   project   management
*  Advanced project management skills, with demonstrated success in leading complex, multi - stakeholder  projects from acquisition through delivery, managing scope, schedule, budget, and risk
* Solid technical understanding of grid code compliance   and   grid integration —   enough to engage credibly with  both clients and technical experts, even where you rely on specialists for the detail
* Knowledge of typical power system simulation programs (e.g. PSS ® E, PowerFactory,   PSS® NETOMAC,  PSCAD/EMTDC, Matlab/Simulink ) and   Real - Time simulation   is an added advantage
* Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities, comfortable being the primary customer  interface and aligning diverse internal teams and external partners toward shared goals
* Initiative, creativity, analytic and strategic thinking, teamwork, customer orientation and intercultural teams  characterize your preferred working environment 
* Fluent   English   and German   skills   (spoken   and   written);   O ther   languages are an   advantage   given our  international client base
* Willingness to travel occasionally to meet clients, partners, and colleagues across regions

About the Team 

Our Grid Technology team enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.00 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Berlin, Germany; Hamburg, Germany; Munich, Germany.

Minimum qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 2 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer-facing role.
- Experience in online advertising technology, online measurement, Search, data integration and cloud technologies.
- Experience with digital marketing trends and business issues related to Search Ads or Search Ads 360.
- Ability to communicate in German and English fluently to support stakeholders in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience with digital marketing trends and business issues related to Search Ads or Search Ads 360.
- Experience in building proof of concepts using web/scripting technologies (e.g., JavaScript, Python, etc.) and SQL databases.
- Ability to understand technical concepts and communicate them to a non-technical audience.
- Excellent relationship building, relationship management, stakeholder management and collaborating skills.

About the Job

gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for  customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our  customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner.

As a Solutions Architect (SA), you will create an excellent experience for Google’s Ads clients by being accountable for gTech service delivery,enabling sales objectives and own business goal attainment for particular your product area. You will serve as an unified service partner who designs and delivers gTech Ads solution and services across the whole Large Customer Sales (LCS) portfolio.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

- Advise Google’s Ads clients by understanding how Search, SA360 and bidding solutions can address their business issues, by acting as a collaborative and thought partner, architecting solutions and services plans to accomplish their goals, and effectively delivering on, technical, global projects.
- Discover customer needs by understanding clients annual and quarterly issues/goals in collaboration with sales, assessing and prioritizing where gTech Ads can add value and drive uplift, and securing executive client buy-in.
- Participate in ideation and design of a joint services plan by aligning solutions to client focus areas. Unlock new opportunities for growth by scoping projects.
- Deliver services and solutions working closely with other specialists and gTech Ads delivery teams in the region and the hub.
- Conduct regular debriefs with clients and Sales Teams, gathering insights on clients business objectives.
